_comment: "You may discard a card WITH WATERY GRAVE. IF YOU DO, draw a card." The keyword was expressed as an effect-level `conditions` gate -- CARD_IN_ZONE zone:hand keyword:WATERY_GRAVE -- which asks whether SUCH A CARD IS SOMEWHERE IN HAND and then discards hand position 0, which need not be that card. The same gate was repeated on the DRAW, so the draw fired whenever a watery-grave card was merely HELD, whatever was actually discarded. It is a filter on WHICH card, not a gate. Also removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text; the generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide).
